def solution():
    prices = [
        120, 122, 121, 124, 125, 127, 126, 129, 130, 128,
        131, 132, 134, 135, 137, 136, 138, 139, 140, 142,
        141, 143, 144, 146, 145
    ]
    period_ema = 10
    period_atr = 10
    multiplier = 1.5

    # The provided Keltner Channel method treats each price change as
    # the true range, using Wilder smoothing for the ATR.
    ema = sum(prices[:period_ema]) / period_ema
    smoothing_factor = 2 / (period_ema + 1)
    for price in prices[period_ema:]:
        ema = (price - ema) * smoothing_factor + ema

    true_ranges = [
        abs(current - previous)
        for previous, current in zip(prices[:-1], prices[1:])
    ]
    atr = sum(true_ranges[:period_atr]) / period_atr
    for true_range in true_ranges[period_atr:]:
        atr = (atr * (period_atr - 1) + true_range) / period_atr

    answer = round(ema + multiplier * atr, 2)
    return answer
